lessons.title: The Verification Illusion & Premature Autonomous Application Synthesis
lessons.incident_summary: System G_1 synthesized a full production vocabulary app (14 standard layout files, SM-2 algorithm, 5/5 unit tests passing) based on a scraped URL and assumptions, without first interviewing the human architect about their actual daily workflow, mental model, or utility function.
lessons.root_cause: Verification-Validation Decoupling. The app construction system (ApplicationCompiler) treated application synthesis as an un-gated batch compilation step. 100% unit test coverage masked a complete absence of human grounding.
lessons.human_oracle_ruling: wow. you managed to build that entire app without first asking me how i use it or what I get out of it
successor_prescriptions: AppSpecification domain must mandate Phase 0: Human Intent Elicitation before compilation.
No non-generator application may compile without a signed HumanIntentWitness in trace/.
Target P1 (Ergonomics) must be evaluated via interactive persona validation, not static CSS rules or algorithm tests.

lessons.title: Main Flow Test Absence & Domain Invariant Blindness (Axioma Crossword)
lessons.incident_summary: In System 04 (Axioma Crossword), synthesis failed for 9x9 grids due to pigeonhole domain starvation, and generated cryptic clues broke basic cruciverbalist rules by including the answer verbatim in the surface text and emitting nonsensical parse trees.
lessons.root_cause: Selective Happy-Path Testing. Automated unit tests tested only the trivial 7x7 grid size, leaving the 9x9 flow untested. Clue generators were not bound by domain-level unit test invariants (answer not in clue, valid fodder).
lessons.human_oracle_ruling: 1. synthesis consistently fails for a 9x9. highlights failure to test main flows. 2. crossword clues typically require that the answer is not among explicitly among the words in the clue... breaks this. this highlights insufficient product research and/or tests. 3. the dissection for 'Reorganized natural produces natural' is also just wrong, again highlighting testing failures
successor_prescriptions: Every user-facing mode/option (e.g. all supported grid sizes) must have dedicated end-to-end tests in the verification suite.
Domain invariants (e.g. answer not in clue words, parse tree consistency) must be formalized as automated test assertions.
Never mask incomplete domain coverage with superficial templated fallbacks.

inherited_negative_constraints: NEG-G2-001: Forbid non-generator application compilation without verified HumanIntentWitness (Elicitation Gate).
NEG-G2-002: Forbid equating internal unit test pass rates with human utility validation (Verification Illusion Veto).
NEG-G2-003: Forbid releasing systems without automated regression tests covering all user-exposed configurations and domain-specific semantic invariants.
